LanguageData.LP_DA_DawnLight.label: light of dawn
LanguageData.LP_DA_DawnLight.description: Allies within 6 cells heal a combined 15 points of wounds; enemy undead, fiends and mind flayers take 20 holy damage. Costs 30 divine power, cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_DA_UnfadingDawn.label: undying dawn
LanguageData.LP_DA_UnfadingDawn.description: Protect one ally for 24 hours: the first lethal wound in that time will not kill, and wounds stop bleeding at once. Costs 50 divine power, cooldown 2 days.
LanguageData.LP_DA_JudgmentHammer.label: hammer of judgment
LanguageData.LP_DA_JudgmentHammer.description: Smash one enemy with 35 holy damage and stun them for 2 seconds. Costs 30 divine power, cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_DA_JusticeShield.label: shield of justice
LanguageData.LP_DA_JusticeShield.description: Allied humanlikes within 8 cells get +20% armor (sharp, blunt) for 1 day. Costs 40 divine power, cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_DA_Dominate.label: dominate
LanguageData.LP_DA_Dominate.description: Dominate the mind of one humanlike enemy: for 12 hours they fight on your side, then return to their original faction. Psychically deaf people are unaffected. Costs 60 divine power, cooldown 2 days.
LanguageData.LP_DA_CrownOfDread.label: crown of dread
LanguageData.LP_DA_CrownOfDread.description: Enemies within 7 cells flee in terror. Costs 40 divine power, cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_DA_ThunderWrath.label: thunder wrath
LanguageData.LP_DA_ThunderWrath.description: Call down 3 lightning bolts in the target area, each dealing 25 electrical damage to people within 1.5 cells. Costs 40 divine power, cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_DA_CallWind.label: call the wind
LanguageData.LP_DA_CallWind.description: Brings a thunderstorm to this map (about 1 day), and your faction's people get +10% move speed for 1 day. Costs 30 divine power, cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_DA_Meteor.label: meteor fire
LanguageData.LP_DA_Meteor.description: Call down a fireball: 40 fire damage within 4 cells, setting things alight. Costs 45 divine power, cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_DA_ForgeBlessing.label: forge blessing
LanguageData.LP_DA_ForgeBlessing.description: Allied humanlikes within 6 cells add 6 burn damage to every melee hit for 1 day. Costs 30 divine power, cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_DA_PackCall.label: call of the pack
LanguageData.LP_DA_PackCall.description: Summon 4 wargs that obey your faction; after 1 day they return to the wild. Costs 50 divine power, cooldown 2 days.
LanguageData.LP_DA_PredatorForm.label: predator form
LanguageData.LP_DA_PredatorForm.description: Become a predator for 6 hours: melee damage +50%, move speed +20%. Costs 30 divine power, cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_DA_PsionicBlast.label: psychic blast
LanguageData.LP_DA_PsionicBlast.description: Enemies within 5 cells are stunned for 3 seconds and take 15 psychic damage (psychically deaf people are unaffected). Costs 45 divine power, cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_DA_WillCrush.label: will crush
LanguageData.LP_DA_WillCrush.description: Crush one enemy's will, sending them berserk (psychically deaf people are unaffected). Costs 50 divine power, cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_DA_SoulRest.label: soul rest
LanguageData.LP_DA_SoulRest.description: Enemy undead and necromantic constructs within 8 cells take 40 holy damage; downed enemies and enemy corpses cannot be raised or have their brains devoured for 6 hours. Costs 40 divine power, cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_DA_JudgmentGate.label: gate of judgment
LanguageData.LP_DA_JudgmentGate.description: Open the gate of judgment for one enemy: below 30% health they die on the spot, otherwise they take 30 holy damage. Costs 50 divine power, cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_DA_WeaveMissiles.label: weave missiles
LanguageData.LP_DA_WeaveMissiles.description: Fire 5 homing Weave missiles at random enemies within 15 cells, 8 force damage each. Costs 30 divine power, cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_DA_Antimagic.label: antimagic field
LanguageData.LP_DA_Antimagic.description: Open a 6-cell antimagic field centered on yourself for 1 day: enemies inside cannot use abilities, and divine skills of god-possessed pawns stop working. Costs 50 divine power, cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_DA_OblivionFog.label: mist of forgetting
LanguageData.LP_DA_OblivionFog.description: Release a mist of forgetting at the target: enemies within 6 cells get -40% shooting accuracy for 6 hours. Costs 40 divine power, cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_DA_ShadowStep.label: shadow step
LanguageData.LP_DA_ShadowStep.description: Sink into the shadows, teleport to a spot within 12 cells and turn invisible for 8 seconds. Costs 30 divine power, cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_DA_SoulHarvest.label: reaping of souls
LanguageData.LP_DA_SoulHarvest.description: Reap the souls of all downed humanlike enemies within 8 cells: they die on the spot (bodies intact), and each soul gives the phylactery 50 sacrifice XP. Costs 40 divine power, cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_DA_DeadArmy.label: army of the dead
LanguageData.LP_DA_DeadArmy.description: Raise 4 skeletons from the ground (the necromantic construct skeletons), which crumble after 1 day. Costs 50 divine power, cooldown 1 day.
